title: E0064: XPath injection
plain_english: This rule reports XML/XPath-related calls where user-controlled input reaches the sink. Crafted input can change how XML is loaded or queried, depending on the API and usage.
why_matters: XPath or XML injection can expose unintended data, bypass checks, or cause the application to process attacker-controlled XML content.
what_it_checks: Cases where user-controlled input reaches these calls, based on taint analysis and dynamic-expression heuristics
